products.notes: Digital-only USB bridge: I2S up to 8 ch in/out 32-bit/384 kHz, TDM8 up to 24 ch (44.1-96 kHz), S/PDIF stereo to 192 kHz, ADAT 8 ch @48 kHz, PDM mic input up to 16 ch. No analog mic preamps - not usable directly with XLR measurement mics; useful for digital-domain loopback into DSPs. Free Windows ASIO driver.
